showcase.title: One room, one frame
showcase.text: Everyone plays the same frame at the same moment. Three Stations, one timecode.
showcase.alt: Three Stations, Ada, Bo and Cy, each showing the timecode 00:00:05.967 over the same picture.

showcase.title: Showtime countdowns
showcase.text: Set a start time and every Station counts down to it together, then plays at once.
showcase.alt: The showtime screen for Night Signal: 4:59 to go, starts at 10:45 PM, with You, Bo and Cy ready.

showcase.title: Chat and react
showcase.text: Reactions rise over the picture, and people who join late can read the chat so far.
showcase.alt: A heart and a smiley rising over the film, beside the chat with two messages and the reaction buttons.

showcase.title: Station to station
showcase.text: Stations talk directly, with no server in the middle. The Stations panel shows how close each one is.
showcase.alt: The Stations panel: Bo, Ada and Cy, each with Same file and In sync, and their offsets in milliseconds.

showcase.title: Phone, tablet and TV
showcase.text: The same engine runs on Android, with remote control navigation on Android TV.
showcase.alt: A room on a TV and on a phone, the phone showing five Stations in sync.

showcase.title: Songs, with lyrics
showcase.text: Play a song for the room: the cover, a visualiser and the lyrics, line by line.
showcase.alt: Now playing Second Wind by Neon Grid, with the visualiser and the lyric line Lights along the water.

facts: Stations talk directly. Nothing holds your session or your files.
An invite is all anyone needs.
Share a video from your device, and others stream it from you as they watch.
A slow connection gets a smaller picture instead of pausing everyone.
